pictures.name: JBR1-The-Dark
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A vast primeval ocean in deep darkness, endless and still, painted in deep blues and blacks. A faint wind ripples across the surface of the water, and at the very middle of the horizon the first hint of a warm gold glow. No figures, no land. Mystery and anticipation.

The same endless dark ocean as a great burst of warm gold light breaks across it from the middle of the frame, flooding the water with radiance, rays spreading out into the deep blue darkness. pictures.name: JBR4-The-Letters
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. An ancient lamplit study hall at night. an old rabbi with a long white beard and a warm smile, in a deep blue mantle over a cream robe, sits telling a story to a small circle of students of different ages in rich robes, his hand raised, a twinkle in his eye. A closed scroll rests on a carved stand beside him. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue shadows, delight.
